datasets.license_note: README Disclaimer: scraped from Google Images for educational and research purposes only; labels created by dataset authors; commercial use may require rights from image creators.
datasets.split_rule: After sha256 dedup: sha1(stem) → tune if int(hex[:2])<51 (~20%), else test. Test never used for threshold tuning.

size_bins.definition: area_ratio = (bw*bh) with YOLO-normalized bw,bh; equivalently box_pixels/image_pixels
size_bins.coco_side_note: COCO absolute small<32^2, medium<96^2, large>=96^2 — on this set almost all boxes are COCO-large; primary split uses area_ratio above.

datasets.character: close-up / large excavators; author explicitly advises avoiding small/far objects — this is NOT a distant-site stress test.

eval.note_fp: Other predicted classes (truck, etc.) count as FP for detection hygiene OR are reported separately; primary AP uses excavator predictions only matched to excavator GT.
eval.tune_for: working conf / box_threshold maximizing F1@IoU0.5 on tune split only
